spans.text: # CP-0 — Enel Finance International N.V. historical source admission
## Request
Admit a separate historical pricing case for Enel Finance International N.V.,
with Enel S.p.A. as guarantor and the contractually defined group KPI perimeter.
Target only the EUR1,000m initial 0% note XS2066706818 due June 17, 2024.
Knowledge cutoff is August 3, 2021; the KPI observation is June 30, 2021.
This actual host-session answer follows the retained CP-OS request, with
preflight/context available. No independent-context, provider or native proof.
## Sources
Original PDF bytes, URLs, hashes and extraction history are in the pinned
sources/manifest.json. Page numbers below are one-based PDF pages, not printed
page labels. Text aids are derivative; the PDFs remain the evidence.
| Source | Identity and selected coverage | Admitted use and restriction |

| S1 | EFI 2019 annual report, 78 PDF pages; company/issue context on 4–5 and financial-note terms on 51–52 | Actual issuer description of issued principal, initial coupon, maturity, issue price, yield and step size. Other financial statements are not adopted as a current group credit base. |

| S2 | October 8, 2019 Euro-programme supplement, 97 pages; cover and selected risk/Condition 5(c)/14A passages on 1, 12, 70–73 and 90–91 | Programme definitions, conditions, one-time adjustment and reporting mechanics. This is not the instrument's completed Final Terms or the entire incorporated contract package. |

| S3 | June 30, 2021 KPI statement and KPMG report dated August 3, 2021, six pages | Specific note identity on 5; observation on 4; definitions on 5–6; limited-assurance scope/conclusion on 1–3. It is an interim statement, not a December target-satisfaction certificate. |

| S4 | Issuer release dated December 16, 2019, two pages | Attributed renewable-capacity target and link to the EUR issuance. Its promotional pricing claims are not independent market-price evidence. |
The source images for S1 page 51, S2 page 72 and S3 page 4 were actually viewed.
Other cited passages were read as text. No complete visual/legal audit of all
183 supplied pages is claimed. The source family includes issuer disclosures
and a specifically limited third-party assurance report, not independent
verification of every financing or credit conclusion.
## Findings
Ready with limitations for the targeted sustainability-linked coupon calculation.
The issuer, guarantor, security and KPI perimeter can be kept separate. The EUR
note's initial 0% coupon is a known value, distinct from missing terms and from
its positive issue yield. S3 explicitly identifies this note alongside other
transactions; their different currencies, maturities and target settings must
not be substituted for the selected security.
Source display uses 46.580 and 85.535 under MW, with 54,5% for the ratio.
Retain those raw spellings and the documented KPI definition. Any normalization
must be explicit; a generic group capacity number is not an automatic substitute.
The intermediate observation predates the December 31, 2021 reference date.
## Calculations
None. Admission identifies the evidence and the permitted analytical boundary;
the next module owns the numerical comparison and conditional coupon arithmetic.
## Gaps
The specific completed Final Terms, incorporated base-prospectus package,
actual notification and target-date assurance/outcome are not admitted. Exact
first affected payment/accrual dates and aggregate step-up payments remain
unavailable. Full parent/issuer financial analysis, market spread comparables,
net hedged cost and broader ESG materiality are outside this source admission.
Pypdf could not extract S3 because its AES dependency was absent. The already
available read-only Poppler extractor succeeded on the same original bytes;
no password, credential file, dependency installation or source rewrite was
used. S1's extraction warning about rotated text is not blanket coverage of
unexamined schedules. S4's font warning does not replace primary-page checks.
## Next module
CP-2F, dispatched canonically as CP-2E: use these exact sources and this handoff
for the targeted pricing increment. Separate performance, verification,
publication and notification. Keep issuer-wide credit inferences gated where
their financial inputs are absent. Preserve source gaps through the next
analytical reading and separate report delivery. Excel is input-only.

| Evidence | Admission | Limit |

### T2G.2 — KPI and transition exposure

| Total capacity | S3 page 4 prints 85.535 MW; normalized 85,535 MW | Same source perimeter and observation |

| Displayed shortfall | 55% minus 54.5% = 0.5 pp | Interim comparison, not a December result |
| Reconstructed shortfall | Approximately 0.5428 pp | Same rounded-input calculation; not a forecast |
| Target | At least 55% at December 31, 2021 | Group contractual capacity KPI, not emissions or a current-status measure |
The source definition excludes certain post-issue acquisitions and nuclear
generation. A generic reported group capacity share cannot automatically replace
this bond KPI. Capacity mix alone does not establish actual emissions reductions.
### T2G.3 — social and operational scope
| Topic | Evidence admitted | Disposition |
| Safety, labour and operating events | No event-specific review in this source set | Unassessed; no invented loss, clean record or score |
| Transition investment and operating effects | KPI definition/observation only | No sourced capex, earnings, cash or asset-value sensitivity |
### T2G.4 — materiality
| Factor | Classification | Basis and monitoring |
| Note-level coupon incentive | Quantified conditional cash effect | EUR2.5m per full year on original principal if the step applies; monitor final KPI and the required process |
| Issuer/group credit materiality | Insufficient Information | No current financial foundation, net hedged cost or event likelihood; do not label the amount immaterial or infer coverage |
| Target ambition and execution | Watch | One interim observation does not establish difficulty, future achievement, greenwashing or cash cost of meeting the target |
### T2G.5 — instrument mechanics
| Term | Value / basis |
| Instrument | XS2066706818; Enel Finance International N.V. |
| Guarantor / KPI perimeter | Enel S.p.A.; documented group definition, not the finance subsidiary's own generating capacity |
| Original principal | EUR1,000m; current residual principal is not separately certified here |
